title: Add Watermark to PDF: Text or Image, Free Online
description: Add a watermark to PDF in your browser: text or logo, single or tiled, any pages, with opacity and angle. Free, nothing is uploaded.
promise: Add watermark to PDF pages: stamp text such as CONFIDENTIAL or your logo, single or tiled, on all pages or a range. Nothing is uploaded.
